unit.name: Generic 250 kVA ONAN Distribution Transformer (11 kV / 0.4 kV)
unit.source: IEEE C57.91-2011; IEC 60076-1:2011; ABB Distribution Transformer Manual (2016)

P_no_load_W.note: No-load (core) loss P_0 at rated voltage — sets shunt core-loss branch R_c

P_load_loss_W.note: Load (copper) loss P_k at rated current and 75 degC — sets series winding R_eq

u_k_pu.note: Short-circuit (impedance) voltage 4% — sets series leakage reactance X_eq

i_0_pu.note: No-load (magnetizing) current as fraction of rated current — sets magnetizing reactance X_m

T_ref_winding.note: IEC/IEEE reference winding temperature for P_k

theta_oil_rise_rated_K.note: Rated top-oil temperature rise above ambient (ONAN)

theta_hs_grad_rated_K.note: Rated hot-spot-to-top-oil gradient at rated current

tau_oil_min.note: Top-oil thermal time constant (IEEE C57.91 Annex G typical ONAN)

n_oil.note: Oil thermal exponent (IEEE C57.91 / IEC 60076-7, ONAN)

cp_oil.note: Specific heat of transformer mineral oil

cp_steel.note: Specific heat of core + copper active part (effective)
